test_ignored_channels_blocks_messages: test that messages in Discord channels listed in DISCORD_IGNORED_CHANNELS are silently dropped
test_ignored_channels_csv_parsing: test that multiple channel IDs are correctly parsed from the DISCORD_IGNORED_CHANNELS CSV environment variable
test_ignored_channel_thread_parent_match: test that messages in threads whose parent channel is ignored are also blocked
test_no_thread_channel_skips_auto_thread: test that channels in DISCORD_NO_THREAD_CHANNELS do not trigger auto-thread creation
test_config_bridges_ignored_channels: test that gateway/config.py bridges discord.ignored_channels from YAML config to DISCORD_IGNORED_CHANNELS env var
